style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, dry deadpan satire, vertical 9:16, taller than wide
motion_rule: the belt races all clip and never stops; the camera rides it with him and takes a new shot size every beat; every beat holds two named moves at their own times, in opposite directions; he never stops against a prop, he rides it; his head fills two thirds of frame height every window, jaw visible; motion across frame only, never up or down
character: a lean chameleon in a grey clerk's collar on the racing belt, four feet, head and jaw clear, two thirds of frame height
second_characters: ONE rat packer on the rail a shoulder from the lens, working on the move, crossing frame every beat
props: ONE blank white price tag on a stalk bolted to the belt, no marks, growing taller every beat; A SWARM of dark jars streaming past; ONE crate of crickets; ONE trolley racing the aisle
environment: a narrow supermarket aisle, dark jar shelves to the ceiling tearing past every beat, the belt racing down the middle, white noon, hard rim light on his head and the tag

audio.delivery: a level flat male voice, each word bitten off, even 4.3 syllables/sec, beats filled edge to edge
audio.pronunciation: TSEN-nik VY-ros, pod TSVET, me-NYA ne VID-no, SLIL-sya s TSEN-ni-kom, ni-KTO, poz-VO-lit
audio.pacing: speech unbroken 0.00 to 7.20, first word at 0.00, no gaps; after 7.20 belt, jars and market roar fill the track to 10.00
audio.lip_sync: his jaw opens on every syllable, no voice over
audio.sfx: belt rumble all clip, jars rattling, chatter

timeline.a: 0.00-0.45 he hurls the crate of crickets across off the belt; 0.45-0.90 the stalk shoots up past him and he swings back the other way, jars tearing past
0.90-1.25 he throws himself across from the belt onto the stalk; 1.25-1.60 the rat rolls his crate the other way at the lens
1.60-2.20 he runs the belt against its own rush, jars streaming past the other way; 2.20-2.75 his hide rips grey to tag white on the run and he cuts back across, white on dark jars
2.75-3.30 he slams into the stalk and the stalk rides off across with him; 3.30-3.85 the rat swings his crate under it the other way, a wall of jars rolling past
3.85-4.55 he leaps across off the belt onto the racing trolley; 4.55-5.30 the trolley tears past the lens the other way, the stalk shooting up beside it
5.30-6.30 the rat rips a case open at the lens and dark jars fan out over the belt; 6.30-7.20 he vaults the fan head first at the lens, jaw open, white hide flaring against them
7.20-7.60 he dives head first at the lens off the belt, jaw open; 7.60-8.00 the rat sweeps his crate across behind him, the stalk shooting up again
8.00-8.40 the trolley rips across at the lens with him on its rail; 8.40-8.80 he swings off the other way onto the belt, jars streaming
8.80-9.40 he throws himself at the lens along the belt, jaw open, the towering tag at the frame edge; 9.40-10.00 the rat rolls the last case across past him

must_appear: racing belt, streaming dark jars and a crossing rat every beat; two opposite moves inside every beat; his hide tag white from 2.20 on, always against dark jars; at 6.30 his head on the lens, jaw open
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, horizontal frame, a static camera, a still background, a stopped belt, a hero flattened against a prop or held in one pose, a pale hero on a pale field, a wide or distant hero, a hero moving up or down the frame, slow motion, night, dark scene, writing, digits, a word not in the lines, a closed jaw while speaking, hands grabbing or carrying the hero, extra limbs, multiple chameleons, foreign accent
